Question: What does each plane hold, and what may the model do?
Construction and data: Names and counts read from the code at this commit (the kernel's runtime, the providers, the TCM catalogue and data hub, the source cards, the registries and engines); the connectors' live-verification record
Principal result: 117 public sources in 29 domains with 444 typed operations, all 444 verified live (2026-09-17 to 2026-10-07); a catalogue of 136 TCM databases (56 reachable live) and a hub of 76 datasets; 8 source cards; 150 native tools in 12 domains; 2,567 federated capabilities from 16 projects; 71 compiler diagnostics in 8 families; 19 claim codes
What it does not show: That a registered source is fit for a given claim; isolation: components running in-process are not isolated, the bundled sandbox is a no-op, and the audit chain is tamper-evident, not tamper-proof

Question: Can a prediction be released as a fact?
Construction and data: The kernel's design × claim matrix (16 designs × 8 claim kinds), checked against the compile-time table; 15 drafted claims through three end-to-end chains
Principal result: An in-silico design licenses only a mechanism hypothesis; 5 of 15 drafted claims allowed and 10 refused, each with its codes; every verdict as the case expects (11 regenerated here)
What it does not show: That the matrix is right: it encodes a judgement about evidence that is enforced, not validated by an expert panel; the claims were drafted by people, not a model

Question: Does the governance stop scientific errors, and which layer does it?
Construction and data: Mutation testing: 10 base outputs (6 Chinese, 4 English) × 26 error classes = 121 mutants; 5 gates; 14 configurations
Principal result: Errors released: no governance 121/121 (100%; 95% CI 97–100%); domain layer 57/121 (47%; 95% CI 38–56%); kernel 7/121 (6%; 95% CI 3–11%); full stack 0/121 (0%; 95% CI 0–3%). Correct outputs refused: 0/10 in every configuration. Errors only one gate stops: output gate 42, ingest 10, claim contract 6, release path 1, licensing 0
What it does not show: Field error rates: cases and operators were written by the gates' authors; with no survivors left the benchmark guards against regression and no longer discriminates

Question: Are the study-design labels the types rest on correct?
Construction and data: 478 open-access abstracts (CC BY or CC0; 430 English, 48 Chinese) in 18 strata; reference: PubMed publication type; rules changed on dev (176), test (302) read once
Principal result: Test: readings agreeing with PubMed 191/196 (97%; 95% CI 94–99%); studies typed 192/245 (78%; 95% CI 73–83%); negatives typed 4/57 (7%; 95% CI 3–17%); 5 wrong readings; hand-checked PCO values 23/30 (77%; 95% CI 59–88%)
What it does not show: Agreement with the truth: the reference is an indexer's label; the mix is stratified, not literature at large; one reader, not blinded, checked the PCO values

Question: What does the 葛根芩连汤 network-pharmacology signal rest on?
Construction and data: 1,792 constituents (NPASS, CMAUP, LOTUS); 391 assayed proteins; PubChem BioAssay 143,679 definitive results on 1,029 proteins; Reactome; Open Targets 26.09
Principal result: Pathways significant: 66 of 1,684 against the whole annotation, 0 of 959 against assayed proteins. With inactives (472 proteins, 51,304 tests, 6.5% active) 9 pathways pass, six carried by cytochrome P450s (CYP1A2 136/205 active). Type 2 diabetes genes: fold 0.97 (P = 0.59) by genetics, 5.26 (P = 5.2 × 10⁻²⁶) by literature co-mention
What it does not show: A mechanism of action: inactives are rarely recorded, reporter panels are confounded by cytotoxicity and luciferase inhibition, and no result here is evidence of irrelevance

Question: Do the released hypotheses survive hold-outs, and is berberine active at the exposure reached?
Construction and data: Hold-out of the 12 largest assay campaigns and of all CYP-panel screens (4,161 edges); rat pharmacokinetic group summaries (n = 10 per group); 128 active and 379 inactive ToxCast results
Principal result: No pathway signal survives without the CYP panels (two untestable; one at q = 0.299). Formula vs 黄连 alone: AUC ratio 1.97 (90% CI 1.40–2.76), Cmax ratio 0.37 (90% CI 0.25–0.55); formula vs formula without 甘草: AUC ratio 2.61 (90% CI 1.80–3.79). 0 of 128 activities plausible at the measured Cmax (22–28 depend on the unknown unbound fraction, 100–106 implausible)
What it does not show: Efficacy, or a gut-lumen mechanism: these are group summaries in rats, the protocol is exploratory by its own record, and no gut concentration was measured

Question: Does the inquiry engine find the true explanation, and stop?
Construction and data: Three planted worlds on the real 葛根芩连汤 herb layer; three explanations and a catch-all; seven analyses with predictions sealed before any run
Principal result: 3 of 3 true explanations accepted (posterior 0.974–0.976); mechanism claims released 1, 0, 0; network-pharmacology runs 45, 14 and 45 of 67; before any run the usual analysis is worth 0.06 bits, the assayed background 0.43
What it does not show: That it decides real questions well: the worlds were built to have an answer, the likelihoods are the proposer's commitments, and information gain looks one step ahead
